messages.author: a5979a5752c669c8
messages.subject: what is the formula for ULS estimator in Lavaan
parts:
Hi,
     The formula used in textbook for WLS is: (data.cov - sigma.hat)'  inv(W) (data.cov - sigma.hat), where data.cov is the sample covariance, sigma.hat is the model-implied covariance matrix, and W is the weight matrix. For "ULS", is this the correct equation used in Lavaan with W = identity matrix? or any slight differences (e.g., times (n-1)/n)? Thanks a lot!

Menglin
